I can’t join live this time; happy to follow up on any feedback in the PRs. Thanks!

I want to agenda the topic of AI in the EIP ecosystem. I think we do not have to discuss adding `AGENTS.md` to the ecosystem https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12661 but I am not yet convinced if we should auto-merge documents which pass CI and pass the checks AI could do. 

My general fear is that if we write EIP documents by AI and also review them by AI, then these root documents are all written by AI. We should move carefully here. From my perspective these documents are used to communicate ideas (specifications) with the community and also serving as an archive/memory to document why we did specific things. Documents written by AI are clean and convincing, but could not be what the author originally wanted. It is thus important that we as ecosystem as whole figure out what we as community want and collaborate with the authors to reach that point. If this is all done by AI, then the future concepts are not written by us, but only by AI, and this might not converge to the similar specification if we would only do this by humans. The world is moving fast and it is evident we should accelerate our process, but this should still lead to equal results (yet faster).
